title: SepFormer
subtitle: Deployment

overview.title: Artifact in input units
overview.description: Centre selection, optional DC removal and rescaling

nodes.title: Deployment input normalisation
description: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input standard deviation.
Packing and context axis come from the run configuration.

nodes.title: Epoch context
description: Flatten consecutive epochs to one waveform.

nodes.title: Analysis encoder
description: Strided Conv1d and activation produce latent time frames.

nodes.title: Normalise and chunk
description: LayerNorm and linear projection; overlapping feature chunks.
Chunks are feature-space windows, not individual EEG epochs.

nodes.title: Dual-path Transformers
description: Residual paths preserve features; repeated configurable stacks.

nodes.title: Overlap-add and mask
description: Overlap-add chunk features; configurable mask activation.

nodes.title: Mask encoded features
description: Elementwise multiply the mask and original analysis features.

nodes.title: Waveform decoder
description: Transposed convolution; adjust padding and length.

nodes.title: Centre artifact
description: Reshape to epoch context and select the centre epoch.

nodes.title: Deployment artifact output
description: Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.

edges.label: Deployment input normalisation to Epoch context
Analysis encoder to Normalise and chunk
Normalise and chunk to Dual-path Transformers
Dual-path Transformers to Overlap-add and mask
Overlap-add and mask to Mask encoded features
Mask encoded features to Waveform decoder
Centre artifact to Deployment artifact output

notes: Deployment changes normalisation and objective; architecture parameters remain configuration-dependent.
Dimensions and repeated-block counts are configurable; consult the linked implementation and run configuration.
